## Teaching and mentoring

At the University of Guelph, I supported five undergraduate geography courses: Earth: Hazards and Global Change; Geomorphology; Fluvial Processes; Mapping and GIS; and GIS and Spatial Analysis. My teaching included laboratories, seminars, student consultations, assessment, and hands-on GIS instruction.

## Leadership and science–policy practice

My work at BRAC and ICCCAD included multidisciplinary team coordination, proposal development, resource mobilisation, partnerships, knowledge translation, and science–policy engagement. These experiences inform how I approach research implementation and environmental decision support.
